name: Insura
tagline: Insurance for car, home, travel, life and pets (fictional)
rejectMessage: I could not match that to an Insura service. Usher helps with Insura's car, home, travel, life and pet insurance, claims, renewals, changes and support.
heroSub: Cover for your car, home, trips, family and pets, and help when you need to claim. Insura is a fictional insurer created for research.

qualifiers.message: I understand you want to make a claim, but I need to know which type of insurance it is for.
I understand you want to cancel something, but I need to know whether it is a policy, a trip or a payment.

about: Insura is a fictional insurer created for a research prototype. Nothing here is a real product, price, address or phone number.
There are no real vacancies. This page exists so the site has the usual non-service pages.
This research prototype stores no personal data on a server. Search and Usher run in your browser.
This site uses no cookies. Route progress is kept in your browser's session storage while you navigate.
We aim to meet WCAG 2.2 AA. Tested with axe-core and keyboard navigation; no user study.
